description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while upholding the highest standards of quality care. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional growth of a dedicated team.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of long-term care regulations, including state and federal guidelines.
Strong financial acumen, operational management, and team leadership abilities.
Commitment to quality improvement and resident-centered care.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
